description.p: WaveFlow is a local-first music player for Windows, macOS and Linux. It scans your music folders, organizes everything by album, artist and genre, and plays it through its own real-time audio engine. No account, no subscription, no streaming service: your music stays on your machine.

ul.li: Hi-Res files, DSD converted to PCM, and 5.1 and 7.1 played on the speakers they name
Gapless playback, crossfades and AutoMix on the beat, ReplayGain, a 6-band equalizer, speed with or without keeping the pitch
MP3, FLAC, ALAC, AAC, Ogg Vorbis, Opus, WavPack, Monkey's Audio, WAV, AIFF and DSD
Lyrics synced word by word, with romanization and translations, a lyrics editor and a floating desktop window
Smart playlists, Daily Mix, On Repeat and Release Radar, and playlist import from M3U, CSV and JSON
Tempo, key and loudness analysis, a Quality tab that flags likely fake lossless files, duplicates and album completeness
MusicBrainz enrichment and a tag workshop, both with an undo
Six skins and fourteen themes, an immersive view, a mini-player, statistics and a yearly Wrapped
Podcasts, WebDAV and SMB shares, Last.fm and ListenBrainz, DLNA and MPD servers, sandboxed plugins
17 languages, a separate library per profile, automatic backups

description.p: The playing track's title opens its album, and music videos reach the immersive view and network shares.

ul.li: The title of the playing track opens its album, from the player bar, the now-playing panel and the immersive view
The immersive view can switch to the playing track's music video
A track on an SMB or WebDAV share plays its music video
A music video plays at its track's level, with the same ReplayGain and normalization
Playing a track no longer waits for a library scan to finish its batch
A file played without importing it shows the lyrics in its tag or in the .lrc file beside it

description.p: Music videos from WaveFlow Server, steadier playback after an audio interruption, and old Chinese, Japanese and Korean tags read correctly. Each profile's database gets one small change, after a verified backup.

ul.li: A server track's music video plays like a local one, with WaveFlow Server 2.3.0 or later
After the audio output restarts, the track that was playing resumes, at its position
Short audio interruptions under PipeWire recover in place
MP3 tags written in an old Chinese, Japanese or Korean code page show their real titles
Log times are in local time, with their offset from UTC

description.p: Music videos play beside their song, synced lyrics can be read ahead, and a track with no album shows the cover inside its file. Each profile's database gets one small change, after a verified backup.

ul.li: A video named like a song, beside it or in a Clips folder next to it, becomes that song's music video
The player bar drives the music video while it is shown, and switching between audio and video keeps the position
Synced lyrics can be scrolled while they play, and stop pulling back to the sung line
A track with no album shows the cover inside its file

description.p: Fixes for artists, scrobbling, lyrics and the window frame.

ul.li: Two artists spelt alike stay two artists when the files carry their MusicBrainz identifiers
Last.fm receives a track under its main artist rather than its whole credit
Undo in the tag workshop restores every Album Artist value
The active lyrics line no longer shakes on macOS
The title bar WaveFlow draws on Linux can minimise and maximise the window
A track whose file is gone now says so when you start it, instead of showing it as playing while the previous track carries on
The Liked tracks count follows a like or an unlike right away
Switching profiles reloads the open page with the new profile's music
An empty front cover picture no longer hides a valid picture behind it

description.p: WaveFlow 2.0 brings a new interface, surround playback, network shares, podcasts and a tag workshop. Your library is upgraded the first time 2.0 opens it, after a verified backup; 1.9 cannot open it afterwards.

ul.li: Fluid, the new default layout, with five materials (Fluid, Liquid, Pulse, Editorial, Lounge); Studio keeps the classic layout
5.1 and 7.1 played on the speakers they name, folded down when you have fewer
WavPack and Monkey's Audio, speed without pitch change, AutoMix crossfades on the beat
WebDAV and SMB shares as read-only library folders
A Quality tab that flags lossless files made from a lossy source
A tag workshop with a preview of every change and undo, and optional MusicBrainz enrichment
A rebuilt lyrics editor, synced by line or by word
Podcasts, off until you turn them on
Seventeen languages read by native speakers, and an Arabic interface that reads right to left
New On Repeat smart playlist family — top ~30 tracks of the last 30 days with a rainbow-gradient cover
Word-level karaoke lyrics with Enhanced LRC + TTML parsing and a mot-à-mot editor
Automatic sidecar .lrc / .txt lyrics discovery next to audio files
Native OS toast notifications on track change (opt-in)
Unified player-bar layout panel with EQ presets and configurable cover-click action
Mini-player remembers position and size across launches
Audio pipeline popover on the quality footer (Source → Processing → Output)
Wrapped banner gated to the December–January season with per-year dismiss
Performance: parallel library tab prefetch, skeleton loaders, slimmer payloads via shared artwork base

description.p: Settings split into category tabs, multi-step onboarding wizard with language picker, profile delete + rename, persistent zoom with VS Code shortcuts, and a host of library/UI polish.
Stability fixes across the library scanner, playback engine and theme system.
